scope: DEV data-layer candidate only. Immutable actual AVPM4 metadata; no mesh/material/pack/terrain-generator changes. Main untouched by this work. Runtime wiring, combined checks, native screenshots/Play acceptance pending coordinator.

policy.footprint: Convex hull per actual low basal bottom level + nearest real column center + one actual tallest basal-column center. Precomputed from LOD0 explicit Wood/rock quads before release.
policy.transform: DownwardY only; preserveX/Z/yaw/scale/prototype/stableKey; same instance used by collision/render. Flat retained exactly. Adjusted cases include0.1m extra burial.
policy.target: min(originalY,min(lower(smooth datum,10cm SurfaceTop)-local bottom)); tree bareground, rock surface including snow.
policy.sink_cap: min(8m,actual footprint radius*tan(42deg tree/43deg rock)+2*0.63m relief+0.1m quantization). Reject excessive footprint relief too.
policy.exposure: Only1-2 explicitly marked real column centers certify a roof remains min(0.2m,20percent material height) above the corresponding quantized terraincell, including snow. Hullcorners cannot certify exposure. Conservative witness policy; not all rock geometry searched at placement time.
policy.query_bounds: At most32 support/witness locations total. Witness surface evaluation replaces its old single height query: trees<=60 logicalHeightField.Sample calls+2climate calls; rocks<=480height+32climate calls using SurfaceMaterialSampler documented15-height upper bound. No extra location queries.
policy.unsupported: Absent/unsupported metadata rejects explicitly in grounded mode; hull never truncated. Per-cell GroundingRejectedCandidates observable.
policy.provenance: Effective generation version, seed, densities, policy, SHA256 of sorted immutable grounding metadata, and surface/source identity.

validation.slopes: 76models x20/40degrees xX/Z/45degree slope azimuth x0/37/91yaw; negativepositions; accepted full basal faces measured0m max quantized gap.
rejection_cases: subcellcornerdip with all material buried under actual voxelterrain
determinism: metadata identity independent of insertion order

actual_world.selection: 16 steepest tree/rock placements from3x3 cells around fixed historical patch5 camera, not live observer
actual_world.timing_scope: warmed Windows.NET, not Unity frame budgets

limitations: Hull+interior witnesses cannot guarantee all arbitrary nonlinear pits/cliffs between samples.
4 of8 steep selected rocks conservatively rejected for insufficient sampled exposure; do not silently lower the threshold.
Uphill burial increases when wide upright roots are lowered; no per-instance root deformation.
Prototype preprocessing is bounded but must be included in startup/upload profiling.
Native rendering, LOD changes, collision feel and vegetation horizon consistency remain unverified.
